author: Louis Rossmann
description:
If you can't fix it, you don't own it. That's where FULU Foundation starts, but it doesn't stop there.

We're fighting for your right to truly own the things you buy. No forced subscriptions. No corporate gatekeeping.

If that resonates with you, you're in the right place. Join the movement at www.fulu.org.

#FULUFoundation #RightToRepair #YouOwnIt #RepairDontReplace #TechFreedom
title: What is FULU Foundation?
